reason: The bracts of a cyathium (Euphorbia) are bracts of a reduced inflorescence, so inflorescence bract fits.
Cyathophylls are the bracts under a cyathium, so inflorescence bract fits.
An innovation is a new shoot from an axillary bud at the base of the plant (grasses, sedges, bamboos). PO has axillary shoot system for this.
Plural of R2603.
French 'loge' means locule.
Plural of 'loge' means locules.
A soral line is a linear sorus or a line of sori in ferns. The sorus class carries the statement.
Plural of R2607.
The vein network of a leaf is its vascular system.
Network of veinlets in a leaf is the leaf lamina vascular system.
A vein reticulum is a net of leaf veins.
A venation network is a net of leaf veins.
A fruit stalk is the fruit pedicel. It is occasionally the stalk of the whole infructescence, but that is rare.
Plural of R2613.
A fruiting pedicel is the pedicel of the fruit.
The main nerve is the midrib or a primary vein. Leaf lamina vein is a safe parent class (the midrib is leaf midvein PO_0020139, a kind of vein).
Main nerves are the primary veins. Leaf lamina vein fits.
A leaflet lobe is a lobe of a leaflet blade, i.e. a leaf lamina lobe.
Plural of R2618.
A pinna lobe is a lobe of the pinna blade.
A pinnule lobe is a lobe of the pinnule blade.
A corona scale is a scale of the corona, not a lobe. The floral corona class (FLOPO_0985020) keeps the meaning without inventing a lobe.
A nervule is a small vein, so leaf lamina vein fits.
A French 'nerville' is a veinlet.
Plural of R2623.
A lateral pinna is a pinna. The side position is only a qualifier.
French 'penne latérale' is a lateral pinna.
'Upper lip' is also used for the calyx (Lamiaceae, Fabaceae) and for the orchid labellum, so it is the corolla lip only when the part is the corolla.
French 'lèvre supérieure' is also used for the calyx and the labellum, so it fits only for the corolla.
Spathe valves are the bract-like parts of a spathe (e.g. the two bracts of an iris spathe). PO lists spathe as a synonym of inflorescence bract.
Same as R2630.
A secondary pinnule is a pinnule. The order is only a qualifier.
A ventral sporophyll is a sporophyll (e.g. Selaginella). The position is a qualifier.
French 'sporophylle ventral' is a ventral sporophyll.
A pedoconnective is a stalk-like extension of the anther connective, so connective is its nearest PO class.
French spelling of R2635.
Plural of R2635.
'Disk' is a spelling variant of 'disc'.
A subumbel is a small or reduced umbel.
'Subumbellate' means only umbel-like. The inflorescence is not an umbel, and the class would claim it is. Use the inflorescence as bearer with a value 'subumbellate', or reject it.
PO lists pappus awn as a synonym of pappus element.
A corona filament is a filament (e.g. Passiflora), not a lobe. The corona class fits better.
Plural of R2642.
'Filament of corona' is a filament, not a lobe. The corona class fits better.
A bulbel is a small bulb or bulblet, a PO synonym.
A central floret is a disk flower only in an Asteraceae head. In a grass spikelet or an umbel it is not.
A central flower is a disk flower only in an Asteraceae head. In a cyme it is just the terminal flower.
A floret lobe is a lobe of the floret's corolla.
Nervation is the pattern of veins, i.e. the vascular system of the leaf, not one vascular bundle.
Venation is the pattern of veins, i.e. the vascular system of the leaf, not one vascular bundle.
